answer: A workable design: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The dawn of work and the harbor of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a lantern to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
